g.text: Fixed PCA + frozen Bolt: V-only accuracy and CPU latency
Post-T development | seed 92601 | six PCA conditions, four reused Raw references | no CI
Matched data/scaler/cohort within each dataset; no cross-dataset average. Fixed transform: 0 optimizer updates.
CPU: 2 threads, row128, warmup10/timed20/stage20. Only non-instrumented timed20 is plotted; p90 is not a confidence interval.
No matched Raw CPU cost here: no speedup/Pareto claim. Full V FP64 audits and fresh CPU 6-origin replays passed; no independent generalization claim.
